• It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: Full Power!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 or more of the following effects. For each effect you pick, give this unit a number of **heat tokens** equal to the number beside it.

***1 Launch Countermeasures!:*** Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target other friendly **SIGMARITE** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and are **under orders**.

***2 Full Throttle!:*** For the rest of the turn, this unit’s Move characteristic is 10".

***3 Calculate Firing Solution!:*** For the rest of the turn, each time this unit uses a **SHOOT** ability, you can re‑roll 1 hit roll and 1 wound roll for shooting attacks made with this unit’s **Godbreaker Cannon**.

***6 Get Us Out of Here!:*** For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The Castellan-Captain orders their crew to push the Cannonade Cogfort to its absolute limits.

abilities.name: Overheating
abilities.description: Effect: Immediately after resolving this unit’s ‘Full Power!’ ability, you must roll a number of dice equal to the number of **heat tokens** this unit has. For each 5+, allocate 1 damage point to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points), then remove 1 of this unit’s **heat tokens**.
abilities.lore: If pushed too hard, a Cogfort’s arco‑combustor can overheat and cause serious damage.

abilities.name: Special Ammunition
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for this unit
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit is **under orders**, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects.

***Nullshot:*** Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by attacks made with this unit’s **Godbreaker Cannon** this phase. 

***Heavy Shot:*** Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Godbreaker Cannon** this phase.

***Grapeshot:*** After that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, if all of the attacks made with this unit’s **Godbreaker Cannon** targeted the same enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within that enemy unit’s combat range.
abilities.lore: At a word, the Cogfort’s crew swiftly load specialised ammunition into the godbreaker cannon.

conqueror cogfort.name: Conqueror Cogfort
conqueror cogfort.lore: The Conqueror Cogfort exchanges a conventional main gun for a realmscorcher flame cannon: a truly terrifying weapon that swathes the battlefield in sheets of flesh- melting fire. Outfitted with an underbelly transport cage, the Conqueror is typically used in an assault role, delivering troops right into the heart of the enemy’s battleline.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
• The Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Iron Feet** is 3.
• It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: All Aboard!
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 1 friendly **SIGMARITE INFANTRY HERO** and up to 1 friendly non-**HERO SIGMARITE INFANTRY** unit that have not been deployed.

Effect: Set up those units in reserve as this unit’s **passengers**. They have now been deployed.
abilities.lore: The warriors clamber aboard the Conqueror Cogfort and ready themselves for battle.

abilities.name: Full Charge!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 or more of the following effects. For each effect you pick, give this unit a number of **heat tokens** equal to the number beside it.

***1 Breaching Assist!:*** If this unit uses the ‘Sally Forth’ ability this turn, melee weapons used by the targets of that ability have **Charge (+1 Damage)** for the rest of the turn.

***2 Full Throttle!:*** For the rest of the turn, this unit’s Move characteristic is 10".

***3 Repel Boarders!:*** For the rest of the turn, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Crew’s Leadshotters** and **Crushing Iron Feet**.

***4 Disengage Safeties!:*** For the rest of the turn, the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Realmscorcher Flame Cannon** is 22.

***6 Get Us Out of Here!:*** For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The Cogsmith kicks the arco-combustor into high gear, causing the Cogfort to surge forwards and allowing the crew to obliterate the enemy.

abilities.name: Sally Forth
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has not used a **RUN** ability this turn, pick this unit’s **passengers** to be the targets.

Effect: Set up each target wholly within 6" of this unit and either not in combat or within ½" of an enemy unit. If a target is set up in combat, it has charged. Then, if this unit is not **under orders**, this unit and the targets are **under orders** for the rest of the battle round.
abilities.lore: The warriors aboard the Conqueror Cogfort hurl themselves into battle.

abilities.name: Overheating
abilities.description: Effect: Immediately after resolving this unit’s ‘Full Charge!’ ability, you must roll a number of dice equal to the number of **heat tokens** this unit has. For each 5+, allocate 1 damage point to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points), then remove 1 of this unit’s **heat tokens**.
abilities.lore: If pushed too hard, a Cogfort’s arco‑combustor can overheat and cause serious damage.

gate gargants.name: Gate Gargants
gate gargants.lore: Stationed as the forbidding core of a Castelite formation, the massive brutes known as Gate Gargants function as a living gatehouse, rebuffing enemy charges with bone-smashing sweeps of their warmauls whilst their tower-mounted handlers open up with multi-barrelled cannons. When the decision is made for the Sigmarites to go on the offensive, the Gate Gargants part their massive shields signalling an all-out assault.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

abilities.name: Aggressive Defenders
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 other visible friendly **SIGMARITE** units in combat with any enemy units that are in combat with this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the targets by **RETREAT** abilities for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Gate Gargants are too large and belligerent for enemies to easily ignore; their allies take advantage of this to retreat in good order.

abilities.name: Open the Gates
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**WAR MACHINE CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 2 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Gate Gargants part their tower shield, allowing nearby units to hurl themselves forward and wreak havoc on the enemy.

scourge of aqshy alchemite warforger.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Alchemite Warforger
scourge of aqshy alchemite warforger.lore: Well used to the heat radiated by their runic crucibles, Alchemite Warforgers are quite comfortable in the sweltering Aqshian climes. So too can these mages tap into the realm’s furious energies and use them to enhance arcane might.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

abilities.name: Crucible of Rage
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:

• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** units while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The Warforger harnesses the elemental fury of the Bright Realm to enhance their own spellcasting and empower their fellow mages.

scourge of aqshy pontifex zenestra matri.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Pontifex Zenestra, Matriarch of the Great Wheel
scourge of aqshy pontifex zenestra matri.lore: According to the Cult of the Wheel, Zenestra hails from Aqshy; formerly a battle-priest, the God-King granted her divine favour in recognition of her victories across the Flamescar Plateau. Whether or not this is true, there can be no doubting the Pontifex’s immense power.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

abilities.name: Unquenchable Faith
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, this unit can immediately use the ‘Sigmar’s Blessing’ ability below as if it were your hero phase. If it does so:

• That prayer does not count towards the number of **PRAYER** abilities this unit can use this phase.
• Instead of making a chanting roll for that prayer, you must use a value of 10 for the roll that cannot be modified.
• The effect of that prayer applies for the rest of the battle instead of until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Such is her unyielding devotion to the God-King that should the Pontifex be laid low, her final act is to beseech Sigmar to empower her followers so that they might fight on for his glory.

abilities.name: Sigmar's Blessing
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **SIGMARITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:

• The target’s melee weapons have **Charge (+1 Damage)**.
• If the chanting roll was 10+, the target has **WARD (5+)** if it charged in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Zenestra calls upon the God-King to grant her flock greater strength and protection should they surge into the fray with his name on their lips.

kairos fateweaver.name: Kairos Fateweaver
kairos fateweaver.lore: Kairos Fateweaver can see the past and the future, and he uses this ability to twist destiny to suit his own malevolent purposes. The twin‑headed terror is a master of magic known as the Oracle of Tzeentch – wherever he goes, change is sure to follow.

abilities.name: Master of Destiny
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit has not already **engineered the outcome** this battle round, instead of making a casting roll, unbinding roll, banishment roll, hit roll, wound roll or save roll for a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit, this unit can **engineer the outcome**.

If the roll would have been a D6 roll, you can use a value of 6 for it that cannot be modified. If the roll would have been a 2D6 roll, you can use a value of 9 for it that cannot be modified.
abilities.lore: Kairos sees both past and future, granting him unchecked power of the fate of his victims.

abilities.name: Mastery of Magic
abilities.description: Effect: When you make a casting roll for this unit, you can change the lowest D6 to match the highest D6.
abilities.lore: To master the arcane is to embody Tzeentch’s designs.

abilities.name: Fateful Reverse
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:
• If the target charged in the same turn, friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units in combat with the target have Strike‑first.
• The target’s weapons cannot be affected by the **CHARGE (+1 DAMAGE)** weapon ability.
abilities.lore: Tzeentch’s oracle invades his enemies’ minds with false visions of victory, causing them to charge willingly to their doom.

abilities.name: Beacon of Sorcery
abilities.description:
Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls and unbinding rolls for friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARDS** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

In addition, if a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** wholly within 12" of this unit unbinds a spell, no command points are spent for that **WIZARD** to use the ‘Magical Intervention’ command in that phase.
abilities.lore: Spreading his arms, Kairos saturates the area with magic.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 1 from its power level.

lord of change.name: Lord of Change
lord of change.lore: The greatest of Tzeentch’s daemons, the Lords of Change shimmer with raw magic. With a flick of their claws, they can hurl foes into the nightmarish Realm of Chaos, blast enemies with wyrdfire or drive them insane with illusions and reality-warping spells.

abilities.name: Summon Daemons of Tzeentch
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: To challenge the fractal plans of the Architect of Fate is to face strange daemons born from chaotic sorcery itself.

abilities.name: Temporal Manipulation
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick another visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit that was not set up this turn and that is wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase, but it must end that move closer to this unit.
abilities.lore: Lords of Change can alter the very flow of time, calling minions to their side in the blink of an eye.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 1 from its power level.

abilities.name: Locus of Impossibility
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit. In addition, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The aura of maddening instability surrounding Tzeentch’s greatest daemons fuels their own power whilst ensuring that foes can scarcely land a telling blow.

the changeling.name: The Changeling
the changeling.lore: A master of illusionary disguise, the Changeling hides amongst its quarry, sowing confusion amongst their ranks. Upon throwing aside its fleshly masquerade, the Changeling uses sorcery and its Trickster’s Staff to openly blast its foes.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Tzeentchian Deceiver*.

abilities.name: Whispers of Treachery
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: The Changeling spreads thoughts of betrayal amongst the enemy, inciting a bitter spree of bloodshed.

abilities.name: Puckish Misdirection
abilities.description: Effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units can use the ‘Redeploy’ command even if they were set up in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The Changeling uses illusion and misdirection to mask the movements of its accomplices.

abilities.name: Arch-Deceiver
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is **masked by illusion**. Pick a model in a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit to be the target.

Effect: This unit can immediately use a **SPELL** ability. When it does so, measure the range and visibility of that **SPELL** ability from the target. The target is treated as the caster for the purpose of other abilities such as ‘Unbind’.
abilities.lore: None can detect the veil of the Changeling. Assuming the form of an ally, it sows arcane discord before vanishing.

fateskimmer herald of tzeentch on burnin.name: Fateskimmer, Herald of Tzeentch on Burning Chariot
fateskimmer herald of tzeentch on burnin.lore: Trailing flames and maniacal laughter, a Fateskimmer streaks across the skies on a Burning Chariot, the Screamers at the vehicle’s fore biting their prey as they speed by. This Herald of Tzeentch delights in spreading the sorcerous inferno of the Change God far and wide, and nearby daemons are swept up in its gleeful wake.

weapons.name: Staff of Change and Ritual Dagger

abilities.name: Spread the Inferno
abilities.description: Effect: Companion weapons used by friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The Fateskimmer’s fiery determination to burn reality to ashes incites nearby daemons to a murderous frenzy.

abilities.name: Fuel for the Flames
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: If the target is destroyed this turn, before removing it from play, gain 1 **fate point**.
abilities.lore: Even the blazing ruin of its own kind serves a Fateskimmer’s ends, each death fuelling the spreading fires.

changecaster herald of tzeentch.name: Changecaster, Herald of Tzeentch
changecaster herald of tzeentch.lore: Loping into battle on foot, the sour-tempered Heralds known as Changecasters act as Tzeentch’s infantry generals, browbeating lesser entities into line. Their mere presence seems to strengthen nearby daemons’ connection to reality, while their powers of transmutation melt enemy blades and guns to bubbling liquid.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Tzeentchian Deceiver*.

weapons.name: Staff of Change and Ritual Dagger

abilities.name: Weapon Curse
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target was set up this turn. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target that unit have no effect.
abilities.lore: The Heralds known as Changecasters summon the lurid flames of Tzeentch to engulf their foes. These screaming, living torches are thus marked as the next targets to be annihilated by the Change God’s faithful.

abilities.name: Locus of Command
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
abilities.lore: Granted a fraction of Tzeentch’s authority, Changecasters anchor the battleline with their stern presence.

gaunt summoner on disc of tzeentch.name: Gaunt Summoner on Disc of Tzeentch
gaunt summoner on disc of tzeentch.lore: Tzeentch’s dreaded Gaunt Summoners often go to war atop a daemonic mount known as a Disc of Tzeentch, a flying platform from which they can unleash their most devastating and spectacular spells.

abilities.name: Arcane Imprisonment
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the unmodified casting roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed and cannot be replaced for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: Gaunt Summoners delight in banishing foes to their Silver Towers.

abilities.name: All Belongs to Tzeentch
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an objective you do not control and that you controlled earlier in the battle to be the target.

Effect: You control the target objective.
abilities.lore: The Gaunt Summoners have spent centuries remaking reality in their master’s image.

abilities.name: Masters of the Silver Towers
abilities.description: Effect: Enemy units cannot end a charge move within 1/2" of a friendly **Argent Shard** that is wholly within 12" of this unit and was set up on the battlefield in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Gaunt Summoners are attuned to the esoteric magic of the Argent Shards and can call upon their power to violently repulse charging foes.

gaunt summoner.name: Gaunt Summoner
gaunt summoner.lore: To the daemonic Gaunt Summoners, reality is but a plaything to be mutilated and twisted according to the desires of Almighty Tzeentch. Gazing into infinity with myriad glistening eyes, these lords of the Silver Towers devastate the enemy with their master spellcraft.

abilities.name: Leaden Limbs
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Effect: Until the start of your next turn:

• Halve the target’s Move characteristic.
• The effects of the ‘Fly’ ability do not apply to the target.
abilities.lore: The Gaunt Summoner turns the bones of their foes to heavy lead, slowing them to a pained crawl.

abilities.name: Masters of the Silver Towers
abilities.description: Effect:  Enemy units cannot end a charge move within 1/2" of a friendly **Argent Shard** that is wholly within 12" of this unit and was set up on the battlefield in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Gaunt Summoners are attuned to the esoteric magic of the Argent Shards and can call upon their power to violently repulse charging foes.

abilities.name: All Belongs to Tzeentch
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an objective you do not control and that you controlled earlier in the battle to be the target.

Effect: You control the target objective.
abilities.lore: The Gaunt Summoners have spent centuries remaking reality in their master’s image.

fatemaster.name: Fatemaster
fatemaster.lore: The military masterminds of the Arcanite cults, Fatemasters are charismatic firebrands who weave plots and illusions to ensure their enemies’ annihilation. Their cursed glaive carves through flesh and metal with unnatural ease, while a loyal Twistwing familiar provides them with an unimpeded view of the battlefield.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Arcanite Cabalist*.

abilities.name: Long in the Planning
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Spend 2 **fate points**. Then, pick a visible friendly Arcanite unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time an enemy unit ends a charge move within 3" of the target, you can remove the target from the battlefield and set it up in reserve **masked by illusion**.
abilities.lore: Carefully prepared deceptions and illusions pave the way for a merciless Arcanite assault.

abilities.name: Bound Retinue
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is **masked by illusion**. Pick up to 1 other friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** to be the target.

Effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up the target wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The Fatemaster’s Twistwing relays the locations of favoured followers, and when the uprising breaks out, it is these chosen blades who form an honour guard for their master.

magister on disc of tzeentch.name: Magister on Disc of Tzeentch
magister on disc of tzeentch.lore: Magisters are powerful sorcerers in service to Tzeentch. Filled with eldritch energies as they ride their Disc of Tzeentch, they unleash a magical onslaught to annihilate the foe, channelling the surging energies of change in order to redouble their own warriors’ attacks.

abilities.name: Spellmaster
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a **WIZARD** within 30" of this unit and the casting roll equalled or exceeded the spell’s casting value and that spell has not been unbound
abilities.description:
Effect: Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved.

If the spell is unbound, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the phase.
abilities.lore: Tzeentch’s foremost mortal disciples are masters of magic, capable of absorbing powerful arcana to fuel their own spells.

abilities.name: Fates Converge
abilities.description: Effect: While you have 6 or more **fate points**, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **ARCANITE** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: As the paths of Tzeentch’s endless plots cross, the Magister imbues their warriors with a sense of destiny.

magister.name: Magister
magister.lore: As a central figure of the cabal that leads an Arcanite cult, a Magister will use all their fell powers to inflict change and ruin upon the Mortal Realms in the name of the Great Conspirator. Those who enter battle on foot are master enchanters who can imbue their allies’ blades with arcane flames.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Arcanite Cabalist*.

abilities.name: Spellmaster
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a **WIZARD** within 30" of this unit and the casting roll equalled or exceeded the spell’s casting value and that spell has not been unbound
abilities.description:
Effect: Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved.

If the spell is unbound, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the phase.
abilities.lore: Magisters are attuned to magical energy and can harness the raw essence of Chaos. There are those however, that delve too deep into this source of power.

abilities.name: Imbued With Arcane Fire
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **ARCANITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: The target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The Magister sets their allies’ blades ablaze with deadly wyrdflame that can melt through steel.

ogroid thaumaturge.name: Ogroid Thaumaturge
ogroid thaumaturge.lore: Combining bestial strength with dark occult powers, the Ogroid Thaumaturge is a deadly foe. With snarled invocations, it hurls blasts of devastating magic into the enemy ranks, absorbing the eldritch aura of those spellcasters or divine champions that it kills.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Arcanite Cabalist*.

abilities.name: Thaumaturge Hunger
abilities.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a **SPELL** ability for a unit within 30" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can move 6". It can move into combat and must end that move closer to the caster. If this unit was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: The ogroid senses the coalescence of arcane motes and charges forth in search of this brewing power.

abilities.name: Arcane Absorption
abilities.description:
Effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** by this unit’s attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed:

• **Heal (7)** this unit.
• Add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle.

This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.
abilities.lore: Ogroid Thaumaturges feast upon the eldritch power of those they slay.

curseling eye of tzeentch.name: Curseling, Eye of Tzeentch
curseling eye of tzeentch.lore: A Curseling is a potent warrior-mage imbued with daemonic power through a conjoined, spell-moulding Tretchlet. They love nothing more than overwhelming their foes with an arcane onslaught, melting their armour to liquid before dealing a killing blow.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Arcanite Cabalist*.

weapons.name: Staff of Tzeentch and Blazing Sword

abilities.name: With Spell and Sword
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, it can use a non-**SUMMON SPELL** ability as if it were your hero phase, as if that ability had the **UNLIMITED** keyword and as if this unit had not cast any spells this turn.
abilities.lore: The Curseling casts deadly spells even in the midst of blade-on-blade combat.

abilities.name: Armour-Bane Curse
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for combat attacks that target that unit until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The Tretchlet mutters an arcane hex, transforming the enemy’s armour into a molten, dripping ruin.

tzaangor shaman.name: Tzaangor Shaman
tzaangor shaman.lore: Tzaangor Shamans are the most powerful of their bestial kind. Born amongst dark omens, they are favoured by the Architect of Fate and granted a daemonic Disc to raise them above their kin. They combine savage strength with instinctive magical prowess, a combination that few can resist.

weapons.name: Staff of Change and Ritual Dagger

abilities.name: Wit of Beasts
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **MONSTER** or **CAVALRY** unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: The target’s melee weapons have the **Companion** weapon ability for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Shaman curses the enemy with an atavistic madness, causing them to see themselves as the beasts they ride – or as the beast within.

abilities.name: Avian Swiftness
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **ARCANITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The Shaman invests nearby allies with avian speed, allowing them to close with the foe in moments.

burning chariot of tzeentch.name: Burning Chariot of Tzeentch
burning chariot of tzeentch.lore: Drawn through the skies by a pair of Screamers, a Burning Chariot rides upon a wave of multicoloured flames that scorch all in its wake, while the Exalted Flamer that writhes and twists upon its back breathes out sheets of unnatural, billowing fire.

weapons.name: Flaming Maws and Blue Horrors’ Jabs

abilities.name: Fiery Death From Above
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 1, gain 1 **fate point**. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• This unit can immediately use a **RETREAT** ability as if it were your movement phase. No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by that **RETREAT** ability.
abilities.lore: The Burning Chariot barges through enemy lines, spreading flaming ruin in its wake.

exalted flamer of tzeentch.name: Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch
exalted flamer of tzeentch.lore: An Exalted Flamer can project gouts of multicoloured flame, turning entire enemy units into piles of blackened bones. The shifting wyrdflame seems to have a mind of its own, forming hideous faces and ominous sigils with its tongues of fire.

abilities.name: Unnatural Heat
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this unit’s shooting attacks this phase to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Add the number of damage points allocated to the target this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks to the roll. On a 5+, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: An Exalted Flamer’s streams of warping fire melt armour to slag and devour defensive wards.

abilities.name: Heart of the Inferno
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 2 visible friendly **FLAMERS OF TZEENTCH** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the targets’ shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Exalted Flamer causes the fires of its lesser kin to reach truly horrific levels of intensity.

flamers of tzeentch.name: Flamers of Tzeentch
flamers of tzeentch.lore: Bounding in a disturbing fashion, Flamers of Tzeentch spring towards the foe spouting the warpfires of Chaos. No natural flames, these conjurations twist and warp the victim’s flesh, unable to be quenched by either water or magical means as they eat through everything they touch.

abilities.name: Capricious Wyrdflame
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.

Effect: The target has the **BURNING** keyword for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: The mutagenic fires expelled by Flamers are most drawn to those already ablaze with the potential for change.

abilities.name: Lingering Burns
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed. Pick any number of **BURNING** enemy units to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 1, the target no longer has the **BURNING** keyword. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Wyrdflame clings to the enemy, near impossible to quench as it agonisingly devours their bodies and souls.

screamers of tzeentch.name: Screamers of Tzeentch
screamers of tzeentch.lore: Speeding blurs that leave shimmering trails of change-magic in the air, Screamers streak across the skies with a wailing cry. They slash those foes they pass with razor-sharp horns and fins, and they have a particular taste for enemy spells and conjurations.

abilities.name: Drawn to Magic
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick an enemy **MANIFESTATION** to be the target. Then, make a charge roll of 3D6.

Effect: This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of the target. If it does so, this unit has charged.

Then, if this unit charged this turn, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy **MANIFESTATION** in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: These eldritch creatures like to feast upon arcane manifestations, which they hungrily pursue on sight.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

pink horrors.name: Pink Horrors
pink horrors.lore: Gibbering and warbling, the luminescent Pink Horrors whirl and flail, generating raw magic that can manifest as blasts of unnatural fire that scour the enemy. Should they be slain, Pink Horrors can split in twain to form two lesser incarnations.

abilities.name: Lunatic Demise
abilities.description:
Effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain, before removing the model from play, pick 1 of the following effects:

***Split:*** Pick a visible friendly **Blue Horrors and Brimstone Horrors** unit within 12" of this unit. Return up to 2 slain **Blue Horror** models to that unit.

***Petty Vengeance:*** Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target, then roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Should a Pink Horror be slain, it is capable of bursting into two smaller daemons or else detonating in a blast of wyrdflame.

blue horrors and brimstone horrors.name: Blue Horrors and Brimstone Horrors
blue horrors and brimstone horrors.lore: Blue Horrors are grumbling daemons that despise existence and all who dwell within it, and they delight in burning it down. If they are destroyed, they transform into bounding Brimstone Horrors that continue to attack with mindless spite.

details.wargearOptionsText:
***This unit starts the battle with 10 Blue Horror models or, if it is a reinforced unit, 20 Blue Horror models.***

***Brimstone Horrors models can be added to this unit using the ‘Split Again’ ability.***

abilities.name: Split Again
abilities.description:
Effect: Roll a dice for each **Blue Horror** model in this unit that is slain. For each 3+, if there are fewer **Brimstone Horrors** models in this unit than its starting size, you can add 1 **Brimstone Horrors** model to this unit. 

**Designer’s Note:** *Dice are only rolled for Blue Horror models that are currently slain – models that have been slain and returned to this unit do not count until they are slain once more. When adding Brimstone Horrors to this unit, do not count slain Brimstone Horrors towards the maximum.*
abilities.lore: Should a Blue Horror meet its end at the hands of the enemy, it is capable of splitting itself into two lesser daemons.

abilities.name: Immolation
abilities.description: Effect: Slain Brimstone Horrors cannot be returned to this unit. When setting up a replacement unit for this unit, Brimstone Horror models are ignored when determining the number of models in this unit, and you cannot pick them to be set up.
abilities.lore: Brimstone Horrors are ephemeral things, swiftly self-immolating in an eye-searing blaze after a few delightful moments causing lethal mischief.

tzaangors.name: Tzaangors
tzaangors.lore: Tzaangors are savage, avian beastmen dedicated to Tzeentch and gifted with his dark blessings. Eager to impress their duplicitous god, the Tzaangors fight with lunatic energies, hoping to earn further gifts of change.

abilities.name: Eldritch Raiders
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s attacks while it is wholly within enemy territory.
abilities.lore: Tzaangors plunge into enemy lands, desperately seeking the arcane trinkets and treasures they crave – as well as victims to be transformed in their own bird-like image.

tzaangor enlightened.name: Tzaangor Enlightened
tzaangor enlightened.lore: Tzaangor Enlightened are arrogant creatures, for they can see the lessons of the past as easily as mortals see daylight. They gleefully exploit their prey’s weaknesses in battle, unnerving them with an uncanny understanding of their strategies before moving in to capitalise with a killing blow.

details.notes: Previously Tzaangor Enlightened on Discs of Tzeentch.

abilities.name: All Too Predictable
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit charged this turn, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:

• This unit’s **Tzeentchian Spear and Vicious Beak** has **Crit (2 Hits)**.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Tzeentchian Spear and Vicious Beak**.
abilities.lore: The Enlightened are able to glimpse snapshots of their enemy’s past battles, giving them a vital edge in combat.

tzaangor skyfires.name: Tzaangor Skyfires
tzaangor skyfires.lore: Tzaangor Skyfires soar across the battlefield, raining death upon the foe. Able to catch glimpses of the future, the Skyfires send their Arrows of Fate on baffling trajectories, striking their target’s most vulnerable weak spots with confounding accuracy.

abilities.name: Destined Quarry
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it by this unit’s attacks this phase to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **WARFLOCK** units that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Skyfires often select a target to utterly obliterate and erase from the tapestry of fate.

abilities.name: Guided by the Future
abilities.description: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks.
abilities.lore: The attacks of these warriors are directed by glimpses of the future.

kairic acolytes.name: Kairic Acolytes
kairic acolytes.lore: Kairic Acolytes are the chosen human cultists of Tzeentch. Each has sworn their immortal soul to the Architect of Fate in exchange for the promise of power. In death or in life, they serve their master’s constantly changing agenda.

abilities.name: Driven by Destiny
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Movement Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is more than 6" from all enemy units, it can move **X**", where **X** is the number of **fate points** you have. It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
abilities.lore: Willing pawns in the Change God’s schemes, Kairic Acolytes are driven by the winds of fate to wherever they can cause the most bloodshed and confusion.

jade obelisk.name: Jade Obelisk
jade obelisk.lore: Cursed artificers skilled in stonecraft, the Jade Obelisk are acutely aware of their finite time as living flesh. They are single-minded in their purpose to desecrate the idols of false gods before their mortal bodies succumb to inevitable petrification.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
details.wargearOptionsText:
***Each model in this unit is armed with Passive Mason’s Tools.***
***•  4/9 models can carry an Antithete Bow.***
***•  The champion cannot carry an Antithete Bow.***

abilities.name: Silver Monoliths
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit while it is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Argent Shard**.
abilities.lore: The Jade Obelisk draw power from Argent Shards to augment their defence, seeing them as sacred monuments to their deity’s glory.

abilities.name: Idolarc
abilities.description: Effect: This unit’s **Idolarc** is a token. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place its **Idolarc** next to it.
abilities.lore: Fashioned from crystal and given life by dark ritual, Idolarcs are the messengers of the Speaker in the Stone.

abilities.name: Chosen by the Stone
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has any models carrying an **Antithete Bow**, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, place the **Idolarcs** of all other friendly **Jade Obelisk** units next to their respective units. Then, place this unit’s **Idolarc** next to the target.

While a friendly **Idolarc** is next to an enemy unit, subtract 1" from that enemy unit’s Move characteristic for each **fate point** you have. This ability cannot reduce an enemy unit’s Move characteristic below half its unmodified value.
abilities.lore: The Jade Obelisk loose a cursed arrow at a chosen foe, marking them out to the Idolarc as a potential sacrifice to the Speaker in the Stone that must be detained.

chaos spawn of tzeentch.name: Chaos Spawn of Tzeentch
chaos spawn of tzeentch.lore: Tzeentch Chaos Spawn are, if anything, even more horrifically mutated than others of their kind. Altered at the whim of the Change God, they tear their prey limb from limb with their freakish array of claws, tentacles and hooked appendages.

abilities.name: A Twisted Fate
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit must be deployed using this ability

Effect: Set up this unit in reserve **masked by illusion**. It has now been deployed.
abilities.lore: For some, their destiny is to become a mewling abomination – they just do not know it yet.

abilities.name: Waves of Mutation
abilities.description: Effect: Each time this unit or the replacement of this unit is destroyed, set up a replacement unit in reserve **masked by illusion.** Each friendly **Chaos Spawn of Tzeentch** unit can be replaced any number of times.
abilities.lore: There is no limit to Tzeentch’s appetite for change.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

scourge of aqshy screamers of tzeentch.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Screamers of Tzeentch
scourge of aqshy screamers of tzeentch.lore: Flocks of Screamers glide above the battlefields of Aqshy, swooping and soaring through the ash-choked skies with undulating grace before descending to feast upon the flesh of the warriors battling below.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Imperilling Slashes
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Screamers’ sharp fins and horns slice apart shields and armour as if they were parchment, leaving the foe vulnerable to attack.

scourge of aqshy ogroid thaumaturge.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Ogroid Thaumaturge
scourge of aqshy ogroid thaumaturge.lore: Creatures of magic as well as brawn, Ogroid Thaumaturges are proud of their cerebral gifts, and many Arcanite cults in the Bright Realm worship them as living idols. Nevertheless, at heart, they are hulking monsters, ever ready to rip and impale the foe with their colossal horns.

details.notes:
This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Arcanite Cabalist*.

This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

abilities.name: Wrath of the Thaumaturge
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly **ARCANITE** unit in combat to be the target.

Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target and in combat. This unit has charged.
abilities.lore: With a sweep of its staff, the Thaumaturge steps into a rift to the Crystal Labyrinth, only to re-emerge in the midst of foes who have had the temerity to assault its devotees.

abilities.name: Soul-Deep Devotion
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit is within a friendly non‐**HERO ARCANITE** unit’s combat range:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**HERO ARCANITE** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
abilities.lore: Thaumaturges surround themselves with staunchly faithful cultists who are willing to sacrifice their souls in the defence of their sorcerous idol.

nagash supreme lord of the undead.name: Nagash, Supreme Lord of the Undead
nagash supreme lord of the undead.lore: All living beings dread the name of Nagash, the God of Undeath. Cruel and tyrannical, the overlord of Shyish intends to conquer the Mortal Realms and transform them into a lifeless Necrotopia, in which not a speck of dust moves unless it is by his will.

abilities.name: Hand of Dust
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Hide a dice in one of your hands or under one of two appropriate containers. Your opponent must pick one of your hands or containers. If they pick the one hiding the dice, this ability has no effect. If they pick the empty one, the target is automatically destroyed.
abilities.lore: Nagash’s touch can turn a foe to a pile of dusty bones in moments.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 3 from its power level.

abilities.name: Supreme Lord of the Undead
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** non-**UNIQUE DEATH** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Nagash is the undisputed master of all undead creatures.

abilities.name: The Staff of Power
abilities.description: Effect: Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit while it has not miscast any spells this turn. If this unit miscasts a spell, ignore the restriction that would stop this unit from casting any more spells this turn.
abilities.lore: Alakanash is capped with gems of purest grave-sand.

abilities.name: Invocation of Nagash
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick a visible unit wholly within 18" of this unit that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly **DEATH** unit, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Return a number of slain models to the target unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
• The target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: In a storm of morbid sorcery, Nagash blasts his foes’ souls or re-knits his minions’ bodies.

katakros mortarch of the necropolis.name: Katakros, Mortarch of the Necropolis
katakros mortarch of the necropolis.lore: Orpheon Katakros is an immortal demigod of war. A military genius, he is a consummate commander; in conjunction with his trusted retainers, he bolsters the Ossiarch legions with iron resolve, surging physical power and uncanny insight.

abilities.name: Aviarch Spymaster
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Aviarch Spymaster can use their spy network to disrupt the plans of Katakros’s enemies.

abilities.name: You Dare?!
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if at least half of the units from your starting army have been destroyed.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round:
• Add 5 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Inda-Khaat**.
• Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **The Shield Immortis**.
• This unit cannot use the 'Supreme Lord of the Bonereaper Legions' ability.
abilities.lore: Katakros narrows his focus to personally deal with a more immediate threat.

abilities.name: Supreme Lord of the Bonereaper Legions
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit that is in combat and has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase to be the target.

Effect: Spend a number of **relentless discipline** points equal to the target's Health characteristic. If the target is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend an additional **relentless discipline** point. The target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn. In addition, the target cannot use **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** abilities for the rest of the phase.
abilities.lore: An Ossiarch force personally led by Katakros is said to be worth ten identical forces led by his generals.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the number after its **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** keyword is 4.

abilities.name: Mortarch of the Necropolis
abilities.description: Effect: Add 3 to the control scores of visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units that have used any **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** abilities this turn.
abilities.lore: As master of the Ossiarchs, Katakros instils in his legions the insatiable will to conquer and extend his dominion.

arkhan the black mortarch of sacrament.name: Arkhan the Black, Mortarch of Sacrament
arkhan the black mortarch of sacrament.lore: Arkhan is a master of necromantic magic and the most trusted servant of Nagash. Roiling clouds of deathly magic swirl about the skeletal form of the Mortarch of Sacrament as he rides to war upon his dread abyssal Razarak.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Razarak’s Ebon Claws** is 3.

abilities.name: Mortarch of Sacrament
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a **SPELL** ability for a unit within 18" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, then the spell is unbound, its effect is not resolved and that **SPELL** ability cannot be used by enemy units until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Arkhan the Black is the master of the Null Myriad and privy to some of the most powerful mystical secrets in existence.

abilities.name: Curse of Years
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 6:

• Give the target 1 **necrotic withering** point.
• Roll an extra dice.

For each 5+ on those extra dice, repeat the above bullet points, Then, do the same for each 4+ and then each 3+. Finally, for each 2+, give the target 1 **necrotic withering** point (do not roll any extra dice).

After a roll, if the target has 8 or more **necrotic withering** points, it is automatically destroyed. Otherwise, after the last roll, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the number of **necrotic withering** points it has. Then, those **necrotic withering** points are lost.
abilities.lore: Tracing a spiteful gesture in the air, Arkhan curses the enemy to age at an incredible rate.

abilities.name: The Doom of Traitors
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. Add 1 to the roll if the target is a **WIZARD** or **PRIEST.** On a 2+, add an amount equal to the roll to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Razarak's Ebon Claws** for the rest of the phase, but while this unit is in combat with the target, all attacks made with that weapon this phase must target that enemy unit.

**Designer's Note:** *If the target is a* **WIZARD** *or* **PRIEST,** *this ability cannot fail; however, you still need to roll to determine the number of extra attacks it generates.*
abilities.lore: The dread abyssal Razarak bears Arkhan into battle, seeking out those who have stoked the ire of the Great Necromancer.

abilities.name: The Staff of Spirits
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit. Each time this unit successfully casts a spell, **Heal (1)** this unit after that **SPELL** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Khenash-an, the Staff of Spirits, grants Arkhan the power to absorb the souls of his foes.

arch kavalos zandtos.name: Arch-Kavalos Zandtos
arch kavalos zandtos.lore: Known and feared as the Dark Lance of Ossia, Zandtos has a burning hatred for the living that Nagash has stoked to the point of obsession. Those with the temerity to invade Shyish bear the full brunt of his undying wrath.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Legion Subcommander*.

weapons.name: Kavalos Steed’s Hooves, Teeth and Barbed Tails

abilities.name: Still Their Breath!
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **non-HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS CAVALRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If this unit is in combat, no **relentless discipline** points are spent. The target's melee weapons have **Charge (+ 1 Damage)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Such is Zandtos’s disdain for those who trespass in Shyish that those who fight beside him come to share it.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Charge
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick each enemy unit in combat with it to be the targets.

Effect: The targets have **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Where Zandtos drives his attack home, enemy formations crumble and counter-attacks stall.

vokmortian master of the bone tithe.name: Vokmortian, Master of the Bone-tithe
vokmortian master of the bone tithe.lore: It is Vokmortian's task to oversee the harvesting of bones for the Ossiarch legions, a duty he undertakes with ruthless, calculating precision. Those who think to defy the will of the Great Necromancer are reminded of the folly of this course by the severed, wailing heads hanging from Vokmortian's staff.

abilities.name: Voice of Nagash
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: The target cannot be picked to be the target of or be affected by any **non-CORE** abilities used by other enemy units for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The sheer force of Vokmortian’s oratory fills even the boldest commanders with doubt.

abilities.name: Mortal Contract
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target is picked to use a **CORE** ability, roll a D3 as a reaction. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target is destroyed by this ability, do not resolve the effect of that **CORE** ability.
abilities.lore: Vokmortian binds an enemy to a deadly mystical contract.

liege kavalos.name: Liege-Kavalos
liege kavalos.lore: A Liege-Kavalos is a cavalry commander of uncanny skill and resilience. With a harsh order, they can drive their Bonereapers to redouble their attack, hacking into the enemy ranks even as they fell dangerous foes with their commander's blade.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Legion Subcommander*.

weapons.name: Kavalos Steed’s Hooves, Teeth and Barbed Tails

abilities.name: Deathrider Commander
abilities.description: Effect: This unit and visible friendly **Kavalos Deathriders** units wholly within 12" of this unit can move 12" instead of 10" when they use the 'Deathrider Wedge' ability.
abilities.lore: A Liege-Kavalos's force of will drives the undead cavalry they command onwards without pause.

abilities.name: Master of Cavalry
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **Kavalos Deathriders** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A Liege‑Kavalos rides at the very tip of the cavalry spearhead, driving deep into the enemy’s vitals and smashing open a breach for their Deathriders to exploit.

liege kavalos on war chariot.name: Liege-Kavalos on War Chariot
liege kavalos on war chariot.lore: A Liege-Kavalos atop a War Chariot leads their fellow charioteers into battle, guiding them in defensive manoeuvres that allow them to skilfully evade the foe. Keen is their knowledge of this kind of warfare, and their command of these war engines is absolute.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Legion Subcommander*.

abilities.name: Grind Them to Dust
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is in combat, pick this unit and up to 2 visible friendly **Kavalos War Chariots** wholly within 12" of this unit and in combat to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:
• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: With a barked command, the Liege-Kavalos orders their fellow charioteers to press further into the melee and crush the foe beneath their wheels.

abilities.name: Masterful Charioteer
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is in combat and has charged this turn, pick this unit and up to 2 visible friendly **Kavalos War Chariots** that have charged this turn, that are wholly within 12" of this unit and that are in combat to be the targets.

Effect: Each target has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: As they plough through the enemy's ranks, the Liege-Kavalos leads the War Chariots in complex manoeuvres that prevent the foe from landing telling blows.

liege mortek.name: Liege-Mortek
liege mortek.lore: The infantry field officers of the Ossiarch legions, Liege-Morteks often fight among Mortek troops, improving their efficiency and cohesion in battle. With but a gesture, they can unleash devastating assaults that send their foes reeling.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Legion Subcommander*.

abilities.name: Clinical Efficiency
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase, Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit.
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick a visible friendly **Mortek Guard, Mortek Triaxes** or **Mortek Crawler** unit that has not used an **ATTACK** ability this phase and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use either a **SHOOT** ability as if it were your shooting phase or a **FIGHT** ability. If it is picked to do so:

• Add 1 to hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.
• The target's ranged weapons (if any) have **Shoot in Combat** for the rest of the turn.
• If the target uses a **SHOOT** ability and is not in combat, all of its shooting attacks must target units in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: With a sharp gesture, the Liege-Mortek orders his cohorts to unleash a deadly assault.

mortisan boneshaper.name: Mortisan Boneshaper
mortisan boneshaper.lore: The Boneshaper's art is that of creation, not destruction. Though their ossified talons can rake through flesh, they focus their efforts on regenerating the Ossiarch regiments around them, creating new constructs from shattered remains.

abilities.name: Legion Quartermaster
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **non-HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
abilities.lore: Though not quartermasters in the traditional sense, Boneshapers are without peer when it comes to reassembling their line warriors from splintered remains.

abilities.name: Boneshaper
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly **Mortek Guard** or **Mortek Triaxes** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and not in combat.
abilities.lore: The Boneshaper uses their arcane arts to form shattered bones into new Ossiarch constructs.

mortisan soulreaper.name: Mortisan Soulreaper
mortisan soulreaper.lore: The Soulreapers are the more destructive members of the Mortisan order. It is their role to cut the souls from the enemy with their magical scythes, using the harvested spirits to sap their enemies' strength or fuel a burst of deathly energy.

abilities.name: Necrotic Blast
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. After this ability has been resolved, you gain a number of **relentless discipline** points equal to the number of total damage points allocated by this ability this turn.
abilities.lore: The Soulreaper sends a surge of deathly energy across the battlefield that can see nearby foes wracked with soul deep agony.

abilities.name: Soulreaper
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: The mere presence of a Soulreaper will sap a foe’s strength, leaving them weak and vulnerable.

mortisan soulmason.name: Mortisan Soulmason
mortisan soulmason.lore: Captive souls are fodder for the most gifted of the Mortisan spirit-crafters. Borne to war upon thrones of bodily remains with their own vicious animus, the Soulmasons focus the animating energies of necromancy into their Bonereaper creations.

abilities.name: Soul-guide
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of the caster to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Soulmason empowers and focuses the souls that animate a nearby regiment of Ossiarch warriors.

mortisan ossifector.name: Mortisan Ossifector
mortisan ossifector.lore: Mortisan Ossifectors are dedicated to fashioning the greatest warriors of the Bonereaper hosts. Even in the midst of battle, they can be found developing their craft to enhance their lethal potential.

abilities.name: Refined Creations
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **Mortek Crawler, Gothizzar Harvester, Morghast Archai** or **Morghast Harbingers** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s weapons until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Ossifectors are always looking to improve upon their work, wielding necrotic sorcery to augment their creations in battle.

kavalos war chariot.name: Kavalos War Chariot
kavalos war chariot.lore: The Kavalos War Chariot is a devastating weapon in the arsenal of the Ossiarch Bonereapers. Pulled by a pair of osseous steed-constructs, the charioteers either smash their way through enemy formations or else harry foes from a distance with loosed arrows and hurled javelins.

abilities.name: Scything Assault
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, you can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target.
abilities.lore: The War Chariot's incredible momentum sees it crash straight through the enemy front lines with shocking force.

abilities.name: Pinning Attacks
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: If this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Liege-Kavalos on War Chariot**, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.
• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• The target cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Whether by javelin, arrow or sheer terror, the victims of the Kavalos War Chariot find themselves rooted in place.

kavalos deathriders.name: Kavalos Deathriders
kavalos deathriders.lore: The heavy cavalry of the Bonereaper legions, the Kavalos Deathriders are expert riders mounted on macabre armoured steeds. They clatter into the foe in a wedge formation, breaking battlelines with every ferocious charge.

abilities.name: Deathrider Wedge
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a friendly **Liege-Kavalos** within this unit's combat range to be the friendly target.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the enemy target. Inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on the enemy target if you picked a friendly target. Then, this unit and the friendly target (if any) can move 10". They can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: The Kavalos Deathriders plunge through the enemy ranks, slashing as they quickly disengage before a reeling enemy can mount a defence.

mortek guard.name: Mortek Guard
mortek guard.lore: The Mortek Guard are soul-constructs created to dominate the battlefield. Disciplined, dispassionate and armed with life-draining nadirite weapons, they grind the enemy to dust beneath their relentless march.

abilities.name: Shields of the Legion
abilities.phase: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared an **ATTACK** ability that targeted a visible **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit within this unit's combat range
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks made as part of that **ATTACK** ability that target any friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units within this unit’s combat range.
abilities.lore: The Mortek Guard are the backbone of the Ossiarch legions, preventing enemy assaults from finding purchase wherever their nadirite shields are raised in tireless defence.

teratic cohort.name: Teratic Cohort
teratic cohort.lore: The Ossiarch constructs of the Teratic Cohort are a grim example of those who have failed in their duty to Nagash. Nonetheless, their bestial forms make them lethally adept as hunters and the impure methods of their physical refashioning have rendered them savage in combat.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

abilities.name: Bone-deep Savagery
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can move 3 ". If it can move into combat, it must. If it was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: The impure materials used in the creation of the Teratic Cohort has lent them an innate savagery that is all but impossible to truly control in the heat of battle.

abilities.name: Hunters Unleashed
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.
abilities.lore: Unable to hold back any longer, these feral constructs rush forward to engage their prey.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

mortek triaxes.name: Mortek Triaxes
mortek triaxes.lore: Unleashing death from afar, Mortek Triaxes rain down volleys of nadirite shafts upon their foes. These triple-eyed archers wreathe their arrowheads in flaming soul-essence, invoking unnatural horror in their victims.

abilities.name: Atavistic Nightmares
abilities.description:
Effect: While any of this unit's **Balefire Braziers** are next to an enemy unit, subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units within that enemy unit's combat range.

If an ability would heal or return slain models to an enemy unit while any of this unit's **Balefire Braziers** are next to it, that ability does not heal or return any slain models to it. Instead, place those **Balefire Braziers** next to this unit.
abilities.lore: The trauma of the burning soul-essence is so horrifying that those who witness it are paralysed by dread.

abilities.name: Balefire Braziers
abilities.description: Effect: This unit's **Balefire Braziers** are tokens. There are 2 **Balefire Braziers** for every 10 models in this unit. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place its **Balefire Braziers** next to it.
abilities.lore: These cauldrons are filled with tormented, blazing soul-matter with which the Triaxes augment their ammunition.

abilities.name: Cursed Flames
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: After that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, if all of this unit's attacks targeted the same enemy unit and this unit has any **Balefire Braziers** next to it, place 1 of those **Balefire Braziers** next to that enemy unit.
abilities.lore: As the Mortek Triaxes set foes ablaze, the tortured flames seek out other souls, and the panic spreads...

mortis reapers.name: Mortis Reapers
mortis reapers.lore: Dread assassins of forbidding aspect, Mortis Reapers slip behind enemy lines to target vulnerable leaders. Enshrouded in a shimmering heat haze and bearing deadly necrocaches, none can escape the dreaded bone-tithe they are sent to collect.

abilities.name: Necrocaches
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this unit can move 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: The Mortis Reapers hurl their necrocaches to the ground, releasing the flesh-withering grave-sand contained within and vanishing in the resulting cloud like phantoms.

abilities.name: No Escaping the Tithe
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If there are no enemy units within 6" of this unit, pick a terrain feature within 3" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of the target and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The Mortis Reapers are utterly unrelenting in their pursuit of those who would dare attempt to shirk the bone-tithe.

immortis guard.name: Immortis Guard
immortis guard.lore: Towering over the rank-and-file Bonereapers, the Immortis Guard form a tough physical bulwark around the leaders of the Ossiarch cohorts. Those who come too close are hurled back by shields then swiftly impaled on spiked halberds.

abilities.name: Immortal Bulwark
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.

Effect: Other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target's combat attacks have no effect for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: As the immovable shieldwall of the Ossiarch legions, the Immortis Guard can stand fast against any foe, no matter how vicious or savage.

necropolis stalkers.name: Necropolis Stalkers
necropolis stalkers.lore: Four-armed horrors that possess ferocious killing prowess, Necropolis Stalkers leap and spin into battle with terrifying speed, laying waste to hordes of foes in the blink of an eye.

abilities.name: Fourfold Slayers
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If this unit has 3 or more models, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 5+ instead.
abilities.lore: Stalkers lethally wade into the fray, their fourfold quadrarch masks allowing them to attack from several directions at once and annihilate even massed opponents with chilling indifference.

morghast archai.name: Morghast Archai
morghast archai.lore: The Morghast Archai were crafted by Nagash himself to act as both personal guard and executioners. They soar into battle like omens of death, ignoring the feeble strikes and missiles that deflect off their soul-forged armour.

abilities.name: Discharge Armour
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to casting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Morghast releases the arcane energy in their armour to overpower nearby magic users.

abilities.name: Ebon-wrought Armour
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (3+)** against damage points inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**.
abilities.lore: The Morghast’s armour is threaded with spells that protect them against arcane assault.

morghast harbingers.name: Morghast Harbingers
morghast harbingers.lore: Morghast Harbingers are used as swift-striking shock troops in the Ossiarch legions, darting in with terrifying speed for such monstrous creatures. They descend from the skies like macabre angels then butcher the foe with their darksome blades.

abilities.name: Harbingers of Death
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.
abilities.lore: Morghast Harbingers hurl themselves at the foe with unbridled ferocity.

gothizzar harvester.name: Gothizzar Harvester
gothizzar harvester.lore: The Gothizzar Harvester collects the remains of the slain, stripping them of flesh and storing them in a gaping cage of bone on its back. It bludgeons and cleaves those in reach of its primary arms even as its secondary limbs gather the dead.

abilities.name: Bone Harvest
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice for each enemy unit that has been destroyed this battle. Add 1 to each roll if this unit used a **FIGHT** ability this turn. If any of the rolls are a 4+, this unit is **full.**
abilities.lore: As a Gothizzar Harvester fights, its vestigial appendages ceaselessly work to amass a grisly stockpile of bones.

abilities.name: Repair Construct
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is **full,** pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Return 1 slain model to the target unit. If the target has a Health characteristic of 1 return 3 slain models to it instead. Then, this unit is **empty.**
abilities.lore: The Harvester uses a portion of its morbid crop to restore the forms of fellow Ossiarchs.

abilities.name: Bone Cage
abilities.description: Effect: This unit is either **full** or **empty.** It starts the battle **full.**
abilities.lore: Tasked with collecting and flensing the corpses of the recently slain, Gothizzar Harvesters carry their osseous bounty inside the cages on their backs.

mortek crawler.name: Mortek Crawler
mortek crawler.lore: An unliving artillery piece that moves with centipedal ripples as it creeps towards the perfect vantage point, the Mortek Crawler is a dread catapult that can fire a variety of unnatural ammunition types, each imbued with fiendish concentrations of deathly energy.

abilities.name: Cursed Stele
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn {Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: For the rest of the turn:
