vigilors.lore: Clad in thunderstrike armour, Vigilors are skilled archers who fearlessly scout out a path for their brethren. Their arrows conjure brief flashes of lightning upon impact, sending coded signals to their kin and giving away the enemy’s position

abilities.name: Navigators of the Storm
abilities.description: Effect: If an enemy unit had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units that target that unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: As the Vigilors move swiftly beneath dark thunderclouds, the Grungni-forged arrowheads of their stormcaller bows give off flickers of lightning that reveal the location of their targets.

lord commander bastian carthalos.name: Lord-Commander Bastian Carthalos
lord commander bastian carthalos.lore: Bastian Carthalos is Lord-Commander of the Hammers of Sigmar. As a mortal, he led his warriors in a daring assault against the Everchosen himself, buying time for the God-King to lead the retreat to Azyr. Sigmar looked upon Bastian’s valour with favour, calling on the ninth Great Bolt, Skjordamar, to Reforge his shattered form.

abilities.name: Castellan of Azyr
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS INFANTRY** units to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
abilities.lore: Centuries spent commanding Sigmar’s prime Stormhost have sharpened Bastian’s tactical nous to a deadly edge. There are few warlords more adept than he in all the armies of Order.

abilities.name: Voice of Thunder
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘All-out Attack’ command, no command points are spent.
abilities.lore: Lord‑Commanders are among the few faithful who can commune with Sigmar in the heat of battle. Their words are like booming thunderclaps, each order ringing across the battlefield.

abilities.name: Mantle of the First Storm
abilities.description: Effect: If any enemy models were slain by this unit’s attacks this turn, **Heal (4)** this unit.
abilities.lore: Bastian’s armour is among the first of its kind, laboured over by Grungni himself and charged with the same holy energies as the Anvil of Apotheosis. It is a symbol of, and potent boon to, the Thunderborn’s already legendary willpower.

tornus the redeemed.name: Tornus the Redeemed
tornus the redeemed.lore: Tornus the Redeemed is living proof that even the most tainted souls are not beyond salvation. A former devotee of the Plague God, he now serves Sigmar with an unshakeable faith. Reforged as a Knight-Azyros, he has dedicated himself to providing some degree of succour to the troubled warriors of the Ruination chambers.

abilities.name: Ruination Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
abilities.description: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
abilities.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.

abilities.name: The Light of Sigmar
abilities.description:
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects:

• For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
• **Heal (D3)** each friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit within this unit’s combat range.
abilities.lore: With its shutters closed, the lantern of a Knight-Azyros soothes nearby allies. Opening it wide blinds the enemy with the full majesty of Sigmar’s light.

abilities.name: Herald of Redemption
abilities.description: Effect: If a friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you receive 3 additional rally points.
abilities.lore: In Tornus, the troubled warriors of the Ruination chambers see a kindred spirit and heed his rallying call in battle.

karazai the scarred.name: Karazai the Scarred
karazai the scarred.lore: Karazai does not so much lead Azyrite armies as simply arrive on the eve of battle. None would ever turn him away, though his draconic kin often find themselves unnerved by his spectacular shows of violence. He is capable of taking on entire enemy detachments alone, attacking without discrimination with jets of flame, cavernous jaws and great lashing tail alike.

abilities.name: Calamitous Tail Sweep
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: With a sweep of his tail, Karazai can lay waste to enemy formations.

abilities.name: Fires of Retribution
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit has 5-9 damage points, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons. 

While this unit has 10 or more damage points, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons instead.
abilities.lore: Vengeance burns blinding and everlasting in Karazai’s soul.

abilities.name: Ancient Master of War
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Karazai has seen countless battles over the heady span of his life, and the reptilian fury he displays can overpower any foe.

lord celestant on stardrake.name: Lord-Celestant on Stardrake
lord celestant on stardrake.lore: The partnership of Stormcast and Stardrake is a potent force indeed upon the battlefield, both beings committed to holding off the collapse of order and sanity. Even the greater daemons of Chaos must be wary around a Lord-Celestant and their draconic ally, for they can annihilate any foe in a barrage of lightning-charged blows and summoned meteors.

abilities.name: Cavernous Jaws
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 3 dice. For each roll that equals or exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.
abilities.lore: The enormous maw of a Stardrake can bite a foe in half.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stardrake’s Cavernous Jaws** is 4.

abilities.name: Extremis Chamber
abilities.description: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.

abilities.name: Lord of the Host
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of other friendly **EXTREMIS CHAMBER** units wholly within 12" of this unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Each Lord-Celestant is a renowned and respected leader – their very presence steels the souls of those under their command who fight nearby.

questor soulsworn.name: Questor Soulsworn
questor soulsworn.lore: Stormcast Questors are typically solitary figures, carrying the burden of their divine missions alone, yet there are those labours so vital or challenging that even a Stormcast may not be able to complete them by themselves. In these instances, they are forged into gatherings of might known as Questor Soulsworn.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

abilities.name: His Will Be Done
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit is contesting a questmarked objective:

• Add 3 to this unit’s control score.
• This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Questors will stop at nothing to fulfil the sacred task given to them by the God-King himself.

abilities.name: Ordained Quest
abilities.description: Effect: Pick an objective wholly outside friendly territory. That objective is considered by you to be questmarked.
abilities.lore: Questors travel deep into enemy territory to gain control of vital landmarks with hidden secrets.

abilities.name: Relictor Soulguide
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: You can pick a friendly **Knight‑Questor** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, if you picked a target, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again within this unit’s combat range and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The Knight-Relictor who accompanies the Soulsworn uses the winds of Sigmar’s Tempest to translocate the Questors to where they are most needed.

prosecutors.name: Prosecutors
prosecutors.lore: Many legends sing of the shining angels known as Prosecutors. However, long gone are the radiant winged heralds of yore. As the clouds churn with Chaos corruption, ever more Prosecutors have found their sense of self eroding, necessitating their reassignment to the Ruination chambers.

abilities.name: Ruination Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
abilities.description: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
abilities.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.

abilities.name: Heralds of Righteousness
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.
abilities.lore: Prosecutors cross the battlefield in a blur of light.

abilities.name: Dispersed Formation
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".
abilities.lore: These warriors maintain a wide formation, enabling more precise strikes and greater battlefield control.

lord vigilant on gryph stalker.name: Lord-Vigilant on Gryph-Stalker
lord vigilant on gryph stalker.lore: The Lord-Vigilants are the commanders and wardens of the Ruination chambers, who sequester their soul-stricken warriors away until the hour of the direst need. Much like their kin, their sense of self has begun to decay, but grim means allow them to maintain enough lucidity to command their brethren in battle.

abilities.name: Deliver Judgement
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO RUINATION CHAMBER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: The target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Lord-Vigilant orders their soul-hollowed brethren to deliver Sigmar's wrath unto their enemies.

abilities.name: Ruination Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
abilities.description: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
abilities.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.

praetors.name: Praetors
praetors.lore: The Praetors are the bodyguards of the Stormcast Eternals’ commanders. Their souls are practically entwined with those of their designated ward, allowing them to absorb their master’s wounds into their own flesh through mere physical contact, selflessly enduring while their lord fights on.

abilities.name: Soul-bonded
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS HERO** to be this unit’s soul-bonded charge for the rest of the battle. This unit can use this ability while it is in reserve.
abilities.lore: Praetors are exemplary bodyguards, linked to their assigned wards at an arcane, spiritual level.

abilities.name: Soul-forged Guardians
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit’s soul-bonded charge is within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and that soul-bonded charge have **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Praetors will protect their soul-bonded charges with every ounce of their being.

stormcoven.name: Stormcoven
stormcoven.lore: Stormcovens are elite strike teams of arcane specialists who often find themselves operating as part of a larger Stormcast army. Each of a Stormcoven’s Knight-Arcanums has mastered a particular school of celestial sorcery, and when they combine their talents, the effects are truly devastating.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

abilities.name: Gather the Aether
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to this unit’s power level while it is contesting an objective.
abilities.lore: A Stormcoven can harness the aetheric energies from the ley lines that criss-cross the Mortal Realms, ready to be unleashed at a moment’s notice.

abilities.name: Aethershock
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible unit within 12" of the caster to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the target is a friendly unit, it has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn. If the target is an enemy unit, it has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Stormcoven unleash their stored energies across the battlefield, bolstering their allies or blasting enemies to the ground.

knight draconis.name: Knight-Draconis
knight draconis.lore: Only one who has truly bonded with a Draconith can become a Knight-Draconis. Such unity is symbolised by the flaming blades these champions wield, and they eagerly bring burning death to any foe that stands before them.

abilities.name: Arcane Heritage
abilities.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit or a friendly **Stormdrake Guard** unit wholly within 12" of this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 4+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit or that friendly unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **SPELL** ability.
abilities.lore: Some exceptional Draconith are able to awaken their kind's innate resistance to magic within their broodmates.

abilities.name: Extremis Chamber
abilities.description: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.

abilities.name: Wrath of the Draconith
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Stormdrake Guard** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of both this unit’s and the target’s **Draconith’s Fangs and Talons** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: At their champion's command, the Stormdrake Guard bring to bear the full power of their mounts when the foe least expects it.

lord veritant.name: Lord-Veritant
lord veritant.lore: The Lord-Veritants are chosen from those whose hatred of Chaos eclipses all else. They have the uncanny ability to detect the merest sliver of corruption: a skill that has seen many reassigned to the Ruination chambers, where their assistance in monitoring warriors after exposure to the most hellish environment has proved invaluable.

abilities.name: Ruination Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
abilities.description: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
abilities.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.

abilities.name: Staff of Abjuration
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.
abilities.lore: The blessed light that shines from this staff can banish even the most potent sorceries.

abilities.name: Sense Unholy Sorcery
abilities.description:
Effect: This unit’s **Gryph-crow** is a token. Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for enemy units within 12" of this unit while its **Gryph-crow** is on the battlefield.

If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove its **Gryph-crow** from the battlefield after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).
abilities.lore: Gryph‑crows are sensitive to corruption and immediately alert their masters whenever unholy energies are nearby.

vanguard palladors with shock handaxes.name: Vanguard-Palladors with Shock Handaxes
vanguard palladors with shock handaxes.lore: The Vanguard-Palladors are the Stormcast Eternals' elite skirmish cavalry, able to ride the winds aetheric to strike with great swiftness and accuracy. Those among their number who wield the shock handaxe over the starstrike javelin are better equipped for sustained engagements and sudden charges designed to scatter isolated formations.

abilities.name: Shocking Strikes
abilities.description: Effect: If any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit by attacks made with this unit’s **Shock Handaxes**, subtract 1 from wound rolls for that enemy unit’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Enemies struck with shock handaxes reel in pain as electricity courses through their veins.

abilities.name: Vanguard Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Through swiftness, guile and more than a hint of savagery, the warriors of the Vanguard chamber are able to outfight forces many times their own limited numbers.

knight vexillor.name: Knight-Vexillor
knight vexillor.lore: Only the Knight-Vexillors are entrusted with the sacred standards of Azyr. Those known as Banners of Apotheosis are imbued with energies drawn from the great artefact upon which the Stormcast Eternals are remade; when such a standard is planted near to them, they are invigorated by the magic of the heavens.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Stormcast Exemplar*.

abilities.name: The Banner of the Reforged
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to D3 friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Add 3 to each target’s control score for the rest of the turn. In addition, **Heal (D3)** each target.
abilities.lore: When the Knight-Vexillor plants their banner, the fortifying energy that emanates from it hardens flesh and seals sundered armour, empowering the faithful with new resolve.

vandus hammerhand.name: Vandus Hammerhand
vandus hammerhand.lore: To Vandus’s warriors, he is still the same golden demigod as he was at the dawn of the Age of Sigmar. However, it is within this immortal shell that Vandus’s maddened soul is trapped, haunted by endless visions. As countless Reforgings slowly erode the last of his personhood, he dwells in his Stormhost’s Bleak Citadel between battles, watched closely by the Ruination chamber’s wardens.

abilities.name: Lord of the Hammerhands
abilities.description: Effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly **WARRIOR CHAMBER** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Vandus is a mighty champion of the Hammers of Sigmar and a consummate commander.

abilities.name: Vengeance Unleashed
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO WARRIOR CHAMBER** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Vandus inspires nearby members of the Warrior chambers to strike forth and deliver justice in the God-King’s name.

knight questor.name: Knight-Questor
knight questor.lore: Standing apart from their fellow officers, the Knight-Questors are unburdened by the pressures of command; rather, these errant heroes possess more singular burdens. Each has been chosen by the God-King for a mission of the utmost import, and they will go to any lengths to see it done.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Stormcast Exemplar*.

abilities.name: His Will Be Done
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit is contesting a questmarked objective:

• Add 3 to this unit’s control score.
• This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Questors will stop at nothing to fulfil the sacred task given to them by the God-King himself.

abilities.name: Ordained Quest
abilities.description: Effect: Pick an objective wholly outside friendly territory. That objective is considered by you to be questmarked.
abilities.lore: Questors travel deep into enemy territory to gain control of vital landmarks with hidden secrets.

abilities.name: Heroic Retribution
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **Questor Soulsworn** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Should the need arise, the Knight-Questor will call upon their Soulsworn brethren to make the God-King’s justice a reality.

vanguard raptors with longstrike crossbo.name: Vanguard-Raptors with Longstrike Crossbows
vanguard raptors with longstrike crossbo.lore: Raining death upon the enemy from afar, Vanguard-Raptors armed with longstrike crossbows are marksmen with few equals. They often seek to eliminate enemy leaders and champions, spreading panic and disorder through the foe's ranks with carefully chosen kills.

abilities.name: Headshot
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, for the rest of the turn, this unit can ignore the effects of the ‘Guarded Hero’ ability (Core Rules, 25.0) when picking targets for its shooting attacks.
abilities.lore: When given time to take careful aim, a Vanguard-Raptor can find their mark even amidst the roiling mass of battle.

abilities.name: Vanguard Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Through swiftness, guile and more than a hint of savagery, the warriors of the Vanguard chamber are able to outfight forces many times their own limited numbers.

aetherwings.name: Aetherwings
aetherwings.lore: Said to be swifter than the winds themselves, Aetherwings are often found racing across the skies in shimmering flocks or circling above their Vanguard allies, descending upon any who would menace the Stormcasts in a flurry of razor‑sharp talons.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Marked for Destruction
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by friendly **VANGUARD CHAMBER** units if the target is within 9" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Those who oppose the masters of these loyal beasts hear doom approaching in the beating of celestial wings.

reclusians.name: Reclusians
reclusians.lore: The Reclusians are warriors of the Ruination chambers, their identities eroded by countless Reforgings over centuries in service to God-King. Though they are close to becoming more engine of war than human, their lightning-scoured souls are particularly resistant to Chaos as a result, allowing them to tread where no other servant of Sigmar could hope to survive.

abilities.name: Ruination Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
abilities.description: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
abilities.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.

abilities.name: Memorian Descendants
abilities.description:
Effect: This unit’s **Memorians** are tokens. There are 2 **Memorians** for every 3 models in this unit. While any of this unit’s **Memorians** are on the battlefield, add 1 to this unit’s resistance rolls when using the ‘Ruination Chamber’ ability.

Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove 1 of its **Memorians** from the battlefield after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).
abilities.lore: Reclusians are accompanied by Memorians who serve to remind them of their humanity.

iridan the witness.name: Iridan the Witness
iridan the witness.lore: Iridan the Witness is determined to preserve the memory of the Ruination chambers’ warriors as they once were, before the nightmare of the flaw and the slow degradation of their souls. Through the power of remembrance and the shattering power of their martial might, the Witness will fight for those who have sacrificed everything in the name of the God-King. Accompanying them on this sombre journey is the mighty Morrgryph Ariax, a deadly beast who bears the favour of the Bleak Raven.

abilities.name: Prayer of the Witness
abilities.description:
Declare: Make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, each time a friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** unit uses a **FIGHT** ability while it is wholly within 18" of this unit, after that ability has been resolved:

• **Heal (D3)** that unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, **Heal (3)** that unit instead.
• That unit has **WARD (6+)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Iridan serves as a beacon of light that guides the souls of those in the Ruination chambers, giving their actions purpose and calming the storm that churns within each of them.

abilities.name: Ruination Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-Core ability
abilities.description: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
abilities.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.

abilities.name: Dark Flight
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic:

• 1 model in the target unit is slain.
• This unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability without any mortal damage being inflicted upon it.
abilities.lore: A hapless foe is crushed in the talons of Ariax before the Morrgryph takes flight once more with a beat of their ebon wings.

gryph hounds.name: Gryph-hounds
gryph hounds.lore: Gryph-hounds have senses as sharp as their retractable claws and heavy, hooked beaks. These nimble quadrupeds are possessed of a noble disposition and an innate hatred of Chaos, and they will ferociously attack on sight anyone or anything tainted by the Dark Gods.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Warning Cry
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit that was set up this turn. Then, pick up to 3 friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units armed with ranged weapons that are within 12" of that enemy unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: It is said that it is impossible to sneak up on a Gryph-hound.

lord aquilor.name: Lord-Aquilor
lord aquilor.lore: The Lord-Aquilors are the leaders of the Vanguard Auxiliary chambers, hunters and warriors both who ride ahead of the Stormhosts to deliver an arrow-swift assault. Keen of eye and wit alike, they are capable of enacting blisteringly swift hit-and-run assaults thanks to the winds aetheric, magical currents that surge unseen across the realms.

abilities.name: Vanguard Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Through swiftness, guile and more than a hint of savagery, the warriors of the Vanguard chamber are able to outfight forces many times their own limited numbers.

abilities.name: Ride The Winds Aetheric
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, you can pick up to 2 friendly **VANGUARD-PALLADORS** units that are not in combat to be the targets.

Effect: Remove this unit and the targets (if any) from the battlefield. Set this unit up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up each target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Gryph-chargers can move faster than the eye can follow along the winds aetheric.

drakesworn templar.name: Drakesworn Templar
drakesworn templar.lore: When they are not manning the Drakesworn Temples of their Stormhost, the Drakesworn Templars fight as martial champions alongside their Lord‑Celestant. Such is their skill and the cosmic might of their mounts that they are able to overwhelm entire sections of the enemy’s battleline on their own, the Stardrakes incinerating foes with cascades of fire and lightning even as their riders send forth celestial blasts from their skybolt bows.

abilities.name: Extremis Chamber
abilities.description: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.

abilities.name: Monstrous Challenge
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, for the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Stardrake’s Cavernous Jaws** for attacks that target that enemy **MONSTER**.
• If that enemy **MONSTER** is also a **HERO**, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Templar Weapon** for attacks that target that unit.
abilities.lore: Though not strictly holding the rank of knight, the Drakesworn Templars fulfil a similar role within the Extremis chambers, charging off to face the greatest threats in single combat.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stardrake’s Cavernous Jaws** is 4.

annihilators.name: Annihilators
annihilators.lore: Wielding hammers and shields hewn from enchanted meteoric rock, Annihilators are sometimes held to be unkillable. They do not descend from the heavens but emerge horizontally through rifts of crackling lightning, and their brutal momentum is a weapon in itself.

abilities.name: Blazing Impact
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit was set up this turn using the ‘Scions of the Storm’ ability, pick up to 3 enemy units within 10" of it to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Annihilators arrive upon the field with devastating force, twin tailed trails streaking behind them as an earth-shattering shock-wave blasts apart the foes of Sigmar.

abilities.name: Brace for Impact
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit. If any of the rolls are a 6, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Annihilators brace behind their mighty shields to hold off even the most ferocious charge.

lord celestant.name: Lord-Celestant
lord celestant.lore: The Lord-Celestants are all cunning tacticians, ferocious fighters and formidably effective leaders. To the people of the realms, they are the avenging hand of the heavens walking amongst them; to their warriors, they are lieges who shoulder the unimaginable burden of choosing where their kin shall endure another death.

abilities.name: Furious Retribution
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO WARRIOR CHAMBER INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Lord‑Celestants lead their brethren in assaults upon the enemy lines, breaking the foe beneath their immortal fury.

dracothian guard concussors 1 model.name: Dracothian Guard Concussors (1 model)
dracothian guard concussors 1 model.lore: Thunder cracks with every weighty blow delivered by the Concussors. Those foes not slain outright by bludgeoning strikes are battered into submission, stunned by the azure shockwaves released by those resounding impacts.

details.notes: You can include 1 unit of this type for each **Lord‑Celestant on Dracoth** in your army.

abilities.name: Thunderstruck
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: When a lightning hammer finds its mark, enemies are paralysed by crackling energy and a flash of blinding light.

abilities.name: Extremis Chamber
abilities.description: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.

knight arcanum.name: Knight-Arcanum
knight arcanum.lore: A Knight-Arcanum is an arcane warrior privy to secrets beyond the ken of their martial-minded comrades. Their consciousness expanded by the Hyshian gemstones embedded in their wargear, the Knight-Arcanums unleash storms of celestial fury upon their foes, slamming them with stunning cosmic winds or deadly hails of razor-sharp ice.

abilities.name: Indomitable Loreseekers
abilities.description:
Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit when it uses a **SUMMON** ability and add 1 to banishment rolls for this unit.

Enemy **MANIFESTATIONS** cannot pass through or end any move within this unit’s combat range unless they started that move within this unit’s combat range.

This unit has **WARD (4+)** against mortal damage inflicted by **MANIFESTATIONS**.
abilities.lore: The thick tomes carried by Knight-Arcanums are filled with the magical secrets they have learnt, including how to resist the raging sorcerous energies of the realms.

dracothian guard tempestors 1 model.name: Dracothian Guard Tempestors (1 model)
dracothian guard tempestors 1 model.lore: While their Dracoths charge forward spitting lightning, the Tempestors unleash the fury of their volleystorm crossbows, loosing a hail of bolts that burn like blazing meteorites. They can concentrate their fire to fell powerful foes or blast holes in enemy lines for other Dracothian Guard to exploit.

details.notes: You can include 1 unit of this type for each **Lord‑Celestant on Dracoth** in your army.

abilities.name: Extremis Chamber
abilities.description: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.

abilities.name: Overwhelming Volleystorm
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit’s **Volleystorm Crossbows** to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, the target cannot use the ‘All-out Defence’ command in the following combat phase.
abilities.lore: The Tempestors fire charged crossbow bolts into the foe, weakening their defences and leaving them open to a follow-up assault.

stormstrike chariot.name: Stormstrike Chariot
stormstrike chariot.lore: Swift war-carriages of the Angelos conclaves, Stormstrike Chariots are potent linebreakers. As they build up speed, they draw the energies of Azyr to themselves before unleashing them in thunderous blasts amidst the enemy ranks.

details.wargearOptionsText:
***This unit is armed with a Stormstrike Axe, Gryph-chargers’ Razor Beaks and 1 of the following options:***

• ***Tempestuous Spear***
• ***Great Stormbow***

abilities.name: Azyr Unleashed
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: The impact of a Stormstrike Chariot on the charge can obliterate even the most durable of shieldwalls.

abilities.name: Celestial Blaze
abilities.description: Effect: When this unit uses the ‘Power Through’ command, inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on the target and add D6" to the distance this unit can move as part of that ability.
abilities.lore: The Stormstrike Chariot smashes through lesser foes in a blaze of celestial power.

stormdrake guard.name: Stormdrake Guard
stormdrake guard.lore: The Stormdrake Guard are the result of the alliance between Azyr and the Draconith. In battle, they are holy terrors, the Stormcasts fighting with consummate skill while the drakes' burning breath and vicious claws annihilate their foes.

details.wargearOptionsText:
***Each model in this unit is armed with a Draconic Flamestream, Draconith’s Fangs and Talons and 1 of the following options:***

• ***Drakerider’s Lance***
• ***Drakerider’s Warblade***

abilities.name: Dispersed Formation
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".
abilities.lore: These warriors maintain a wide formation, enabling more precise strikes and greater battlefield control.

abilities.name: Draconic Onslaught
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. Then, pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. Inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.
abilities.lore: To reclaim their old empire, the Draconith and their riders fight together as a single furious whole, savaging any who cross their path.

abilities.name: Extremis Chamber
abilities.description: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.

vindictors.name: Vindictors
vindictors.lore: Vindictors were amongst the first Stormcasts to be equipped with thunderstrike armour, their wargear designed by Grungni to defend against even the most aggressive enemy assaults. They are the shieldwall upon which the forces of ruin shatter. Forged from the most unrelenting souls, Vindictors will endure come what may and spit defiance until the last.

abilities.name: Hold the Shieldwall
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit did not charge this turn and is in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 4+, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Vindictor retinues form the unyielding shieldwalls upon which the forces of ruin shatter.

liberators.name: Liberators
liberators.lore: The Liberators are the backbone of the God-King’s battlelines, trained to both enact sudden assaults and form unbreakable shieldwalls. To them falls the duty of casting down the warlords of ruin and stamping Sigmar’s claim upon the lands once more.

details.wargearOptionsText:
***Each model in this unit is armed with a Warhammer.***

• ***1/5 models can replace their Warhammer with a Grandhammer.***
• ***The champion cannot replace their weapon.***

abilities.name: Stalwart Defenders
abilities.description: Effect: Add 3 to this unit’s control score while it is contesting an objective wholly within friendly territory.
abilities.lore: Liberators fiercely guard the lands brought into Sigmar’s domain.

stormdrake guard 1 model.name: Stormdrake Guard (1 model)
stormdrake guard 1 model.lore: The Stormdrake Guard are the result of the alliance between Azyr and the Draconith. In battle, they are holy terrors, the Stormcasts fighting with consummate skill while the drakes' burning breath and vicious claws annihilate their foes.

details.notes: You can include 1 unit of this type for each **Knight-Draconis** in your army.
details.wargearOptionsText:
***Each model in this unit is armed with a Draconic Flamestream, Draconith’s Fangs and Talons and 1 of the following options:***

• ***Drakerider’s Lance***
• ***Drakerider’s Warblade***

abilities.name: Dispersed Formation
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".
abilities.lore: These warriors maintain a wide formation, enabling more precise strikes and greater battlefield control.

abilities.name: Extremis Chamber
abilities.description: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.

abilities.name: Draconic Onslaught
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. Then, pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. Inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.
abilities.lore: To reclaim their old empire, the Draconith and their riders fight together as a single furious whole, savaging any who cross their path.

scourge of aqshy iridan the witness.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Iridan the Witness
scourge of aqshy iridan the witness.lore: Able to endure the horrors of the Gnaw for far longer than their brethren, Iridan the Witness leads the Stormcasts of the Ruination chambers into battle with the resurgent Skaven in the easternmost Great Parch. Champion of the death god Morrda, they ride atop the Morrgryph Ariax and seek to reawaken their companions’ memories of past glories.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

abilities.name: Demands of the Witness
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of each target’s melee weapons.
abilities.lore: Iridan understands better than any that the most assured way to avoid the incremental erosion of the flaw in the Reforging process is to avoid being cut down, and so they exhort their charges to vanquish their foes quickly, mercilessly and without hesitation.

abilities.name: The Flames of Hope
abilities.description: Effect: You can re-roll resistance rolls for friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The billowing flames borne by Iridan are instantly recognisable by all of Sigmar’s greatest warriors, even those who have lost nearly every part of themselves in his name.

abilities.name: On Wings of Death
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect:  If the target charged this turn, apply the effects below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effects below:

• You can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Ariax swoops over the heads of the foe, robbing them of their will to fight.

abilities.name: Guardian of the Final Threshold
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked to be the target of a non-**CORE** ability
abilities.description: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 3+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
abilities.lore: Iridan does battle where others cannot tread, fighting in lands transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on this shepherd of lost souls, their faith granting them near immunity to such impurities.

scourge of aqshy stormstrike palladors.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Stormstrike Palladors
scourge of aqshy stormstrike palladors.lore: The hard-hitting cavalry of the Warrior chambers, Stormstrike Palladors are outfitted not solely to administer a devastating charge but also to engage in extended periods of melee fighting in which their heavy blades and the talons of their Gryph-chargers prove most effective killing tools.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

abilities.name: Lightning Quick
abilities.description: Effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.
abilities.lore: One of the swiftest and most agile mounts in the realms, Gryph-chargers deftly speed their riders away from danger.

abilities.name: Shock Cavalry
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with both of the following units to be the target:
• This unit.
• A friendly unit that did not charge this turn.

Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Stormstrike Palladors are masters at performing devastating charges into the unguarded flanks of enemies already engaged in combat.

akhelian king.name: Akhelian King
akhelian king.lore: Akhelian Kings are the war leaders of the Idoneth enclaves. Mounted atop fierce and intelligent Deepmares, these inspiring commanders fight at the forefront of every battle, urging their Phalanxes forward as they wield their blades with deadly skill.

weapons.name: Deepmare’s Fangs, Talons and Lashing Tails

abilities.name: Crest of the Wave
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by other friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units for attacks that target enemy units in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: Riding the momentum of the ethersea, the Akhelian King leads a glorious charge to shatter the enemy ranks.

abilities.name: Wave Rider
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Akhelian Royal Weapons** for attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: When an Akhelian King charges the foe, they hit with the power of a crashing wave.

lotann warden of the soul ledgers.name: Lotann, Warden of the Soul Ledgers
lotann warden of the soul ledgers.lore: Lotann is the Warden of the Soul Ledgers, whose task it is to oversee the reaping of spirit-essences across the enclaves. A skilled arcanist in his own right, Lotann channels the gestalt memories of the Idoneth to empower his kin.

abilities.name: Empowered By Memory
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Lotann draws on the accumulated memories of his people to grant his allies supernatural strength and resolve.

abilities.name: Catalogue of Souls
abilities.description: Effect: Each time an enemy unit is destroyed, give this unit a **soul‑quota token**.
abilities.lore: The Soul Wardens keep records of the souls that are harvested by the phalanxes.

abilities.name: Fount of Willpower
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a friendly **ISHARANN** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Remove 1 of this unit’s **soul-quota tokens**. Then, you can re‑roll the casting roll.
abilities.lore: Such is Lotann’s obsessive commitment to his duty that his willpower bleeds out into the ethersea, a potent magical force that can be drawn upon to empower his fellow Isharann.

akhelian ishlaen guard.name: Akhelian Ishlaen Guard
akhelian ishlaen guard.lore: Ishlaen Guard channel the bioelectricity of Fangmora mounts into their galv-shields, manifesting this energy as a sparking field that turns aside enemy blows. Thanks to this protective aura, the Ishlaen are often assigned as the bodyguards of Akhelian Kings or other high-ranking Idoneth, seeking the closest threats and laying them low with sweeps of their helsabres.

abilities.name: Galv-shields
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)** if it charged in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Thanks to their protective aura, the Ishlaen have greater staying power in prolonged combat than their spear-armed kin.

abilities.name: Biovoltaic Barrier
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target unit’s weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The biovoltaic energy produced by Fangmora Eels is channelled by Ishlaen Guard into a crackling luminescent energy field that protects them from harm.

akhelian morrsarr guard.name: Akhelian Morrsarr Guard
akhelian morrsarr guard.lore: Armed with voltspears and galv-shields, the Morrsarr Guard function as heavy shock cavalry, their fearsome weapons channelling the powerful electrical energy given off by the Fangmoras. This shockwave is loosed moments before the Morrsarr crash into the enemy, blasting the front ranks even as the Akhelians’ spears strike home.

abilities.name: Biovoltaic Blast
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in this unit. Add 1 to each roll if there are more models in the target unit than this unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: The biovoltaic energy produced by Fangmora Eels is stored by Morrsarr Guard, ready to be discharged as a bolt of energy when the time is right.

akhelian thrallmaster.name: Akhelian Thrallmaster
akhelian thrallmaster.lore: Thrallmasters are cunning and sea-scarred Akhelians who lead the Namarti hosts into battle. Master duellists skilled with all manner of exotic weaponry, they scythe through their foes with contemptuous ease.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Akhelian Raidmaster*.

abilities.name: Akhelian Insights
abilities.description: Effect: Melee weapons used by friendly **NAMARTI** units have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Thrallmasters are cunning and sea-scarred Akhelians who lead the Namarti hosts into battle. Master duellists skilled with all manner of exotic weaponry, they scythe through their foes with contemptuous ease.

abilities.name: Thrallmaster
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **NAMARTI THRALLS** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Thrallmasters are cunning and sea-scarred Akhelians who lead the Namarti hosts into battle.

namarti thralls.name: Namarti Thralls
namarti thralls.lore: The core infantry of the Idoneth Deepkin, Namarti Thralls advance into battle brandishing vast two-handed weapons known as lanmari. Despite their blindness and the heft of their blades, they whirl and chop with aelven grace.

abilities.name: Sweeping Blows
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: If any damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that **FIGHT** ability are allocated to any enemy units, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by those enemy units for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A Namarti Thrall’s aggressive swiping strikes are intended to knock their enemies off their feet.

akhelian leviadon.name: Akhelian Leviadon
akhelian leviadon.lore: A monstrous undersea titan, the Leviadon is covered in thick scales and protected by an impenetrable shell. In addition to its powerful jaws and bladed fins, it carries a hard-bitten crew and twin harpoon launchers, making it a veritable living fortress.

weapons.name: Leviadon’s Scythed Fins and Crushing Jaws

abilities.name: Crushing Charge
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target unit has more than 10 models. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: When a Leviadon charges into battle, it crushes the foe with its sheer mass.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Leviadon’s Scythed Fins and Crushing Jaws** is 5.

abilities.name: Void Drum
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units have **WARD (5+)** while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.
abilities.lore: A void drummer rides on the back of every Akhelian Leviadon. The mesmerising rhythm that they beat out sends rippling currents through the air, distorting the outlines of the drummer’s comrades and making them hard to see.

eidolon of mathlann aspect of the sea.name: Eidolon of Mathlann, Aspect of the Sea
eidolon of mathlann aspect of the sea.lore: An Eidolon of Mathlann is a mystical conjuration that embodies a long-forgotten god. When summoned in its aspect of the sea, this entity can call upon the magic of the ocean to bolster allies or send enemies fleeing in terror.

abilities.name: Dormant Energies
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
abilities.lore: The Isharann aspect of an Eidolon of Mathlann seethes with suppressed energies that it can draw upon at need.

abilities.name: Tranquillity of the Abyss
abilities.description: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to the control scores of friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: An Eidolon in its aspect of the sea radiates an aura of unnatural tranquillity, calming any fears that nearby Idoneth may harbour.

abilities.name: Tsunami of Terror
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 different visible enemy units within 12" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for combat attacks that target those units until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: With a wave of its sceptre, the Eidolon sends forth invisible waves of fear that cause even the bravest of opponents to cower.

abilities.name: Vengeful Waves
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has not charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: When threatened, the Eidolon causes the ethersea to crash around it, overwhelming its enemies.

isharann soulrender.name: Isharann Soulrender
isharann soulrender.lore: Unlike the rest of their Isharann kin, Soulrenders fight face to face with their foes, reaping spirit-matter with every swing of their scythe-like talúnhooks. In battle, they can channel their mystical powers to revive fallen Namarti.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Isharann Emissary*.

abilities.name: Lurelight
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 different friendly **NAMARTI** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.

Effect: Make a lurelight roll of D3 for each target unit. On a 2+, return a number of slain models to the target unit equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Isharann Soulrenders possess a mystical lure that is used to draw unto them the souls of slain opponents so that they can be captured. Should the Soulrender act quickly enough, the stolen essence can be repurposed to resurrect fallen Namarti mid-battle.

abilities.name: Hangman's Knot
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed.
abilities.lore: The noose on a talúnhook can be used to ensnare a victim, ensuring they cannot escape their doom at the hands of the Soulrender.

scourge of ghyran namarti thralls.name: Scourge of Ghyran Namarti Thralls
scourge of ghyran namarti thralls.lore: Namarti Thralls have proved as skilled in waging strike-and-fade war amidst the jungles of Ghyran as they are in the kelp forests of their undersea home. Enhanced by the ethersea, their extrasensory powers allow them to isolate their prey, lashing out with their lanmari blades before retreating into the shadows under the cover of briny mists.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

abilities.name: Hit-and-Run Tactics
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is in combat or charged this turn, this unit can make a pile-in move. Then, if this unit is in combat, you must pick 1 or more enemy units to be the target(s) of this unit’s attacks.

Effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s). Then, if this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move. It does not have to end the move in combat.
abilities.lore: The Namarti Thralls strike at their foes before using the ethersea to fall back to a safer position.

isharann tidecaster.name: Isharann Tidecaster
isharann tidecaster.lore: Isharann Tidecasters are the Idoneth’s most potent frontline wizards, capable of directing the surging currents of the ethersea in order to alter the momentum of battle or to steal the very breath from their foes.

abilities.name: Master of the Ethersea
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Make an Isharann ritual roll of D6.

Effect: On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:

***Creeping Mist:*** Friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 12" of them.

***Surging Stream:*** Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units.

***Spiteful Riptide:*** Each time an enemy unit uses a **RETREAT** ability, after the effect of that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit.
abilities.lore: A Tidecaster can manipulate the ethersea like no other.

ikon of the storm.name: Ikon of the Storm
ikon of the storm.lore: Ikons of the Storm aim to embody the destructive force of a raging ocean. Wielding twin blades, they hurl themselves into battle, heedless of any personal danger as they carve their enemies apart. Foes are helpless in the face of the Ikon’s whirling maelstrom of steel, and those with a mind to flee are cut down before they can take a single step.

details.notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as an *Akhelian Raidmaster*.

abilities.name: Whirlpool's Fury
abilities.description:
Effect: Enemy units cannot use **RETREAT** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

Friendly units that use a **RETREAT** ability while they are wholly within 12" of this unit can still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units by **RETREAT** abilities while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: An Ikon of the Storm is a vortex of rage, overwhelming enemies and inspiring their kin to fight ever harder.

abilities.name: Storm of Blades
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Channelling the frothing violence of a maelstrom, the Ikon of the Storm lashes out again and again.

isharann soulscryer.name: Isharann Soulscryer
isharann soulscryer.lore: Soulscryers work their strange magics to navigate the utter darkness of the deep places. Their eldritch senses allow them to guide other Idoneth along hidden paths in the realms’ oceans and rivers, so that they can strike the foe from unexpected angles.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Isharann Emissary*.

abilities.name: Finder of Ways
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Unpredictable Tide’ ability or the ‘Steed of Tides’ ability
abilities.description: Effect: Instead of setting up the targets as described in the ability used, set them up on the battlefield wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 7" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Soulscryers are the Idoneth’s navigators, helping them divine hidden paths through the realmseas.

mathaela oracle of the abyss.name: Mathaela, Oracle of the Abyss
mathaela oracle of the abyss.lore: Mysterious and terrifying, the Oracle of the Abyss only rises from their lightless domain when the existence of the Deepkin is threatened. Wielding the crushing magic of the deepest ocean planes, Mathaela annihilates the Idoneth’s foes and stirs the very realmseas into violent motion.

abilities.name: Crushing Pressure
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic, to a maximum of 10. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Mathaela subjects their foes to the devastating pressure of the deepest trenches, causing bones to shatter and metal to crumple like paper.

abilities.name: Siren Song of the Abyss
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ **Companion** weapons.
abilities.lore: More attuned to the heartbeat of the ocean than any Isharann, Mathaela can stir the seas to thrashing life with but a gesture.

scourge of aqshy isharann tidecaster.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Isharann Tidecaster
scourge of aqshy isharann tidecaster.lore: True masters of the ethersea, Isharann Tidecasters can manipulate this eldritch ocean to protect their allies and destroy their foes. They bring the Searing Sea to the Charrwind Coast, ensuring it is they who control the ebb and flow of battle.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

abilities.name: Master of the Ethersea
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: If the target is **NAMARTI**, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn. Otherwise, make an Isharann ritual roll of D6. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn.

***Torrent of Blows***: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. That weapon has **Crit (2 Hits)**.

***Protection of the Waves***: While this unit is within 3" of and visible to the target, both units have **WARD (5+)**.

***Frenzy of the Ethersea***: For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets that friendly unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: The Tidecaster channels and manipulates the deep-sea magic of the ethersea in order to empower and defend their kin.

scourge of aqshy namarti reavers.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Namarti Reavers
scourge of aqshy namarti reavers.lore: Fast‐moving scouts and archers, the eyeless Namarti Reavers are as uncannily accurate with their whisperbows upon the scorched earth of the Great Parch as they are beneath the waves.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

abilities.name: Merciless Hunters
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for this unit
abilities.description:
Effect: After that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, if all of this unit’s attacks targeted the same enemy unit and any models in that unit were slain, pick 1 of the effects below to apply for the rest of the turn. If all of this unit’s attacks targeted the same enemy unit and no models in that unit were slain, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the effects below to apply for the rest of the turn:

• Subtract 1 from ward rolls for the target.
• Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.
abilities.lore: Namarti Reavers can fire arrows with such accuracy as to impair any defence, no matter how strong.

scourge of ghyran akhelian thrallmaster.name: Scourge of Ghyran Akhelian Thrallmaster
scourge of ghyran akhelian thrallmaster.lore: Many ruthless Akhelian Thrallmasters ply the coasts of the Everspring Swathe, seeking out the rich accumulations of souls that can be found there. Masters of guerrilla warfare, these swordmasters and their Namarti warriors use the environment to protect them against enemy attacks as they advance, before charging in to deliver a killing strike.

details.notes:
This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Akhelian Raidmaster*.
This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

abilities.name: Raider Captain
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 3 friendly **Namarti Thralls** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
abilities.lore: Thrallmasters are often among the first of the Idoneth’s forces to arrive on the battlefield, leading Namarti scouting parties to establish forward positions from which they can launch their raid.

abilities.name: Way of the Vortex
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit and friendly **NAMARTI** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The riptide’s undertow pulls allies from harm, a hidden bulwark against the enemy’s raging storm. Within its grasp, Namarti endure, shielded by the Akhelian’s unwavering stance.

ikon of the sea.name: Ikon of the Sea
ikon of the sea.lore: Channelling the unfathomable calm and foreboding immensity of the deepest waters, Ikons of the Sea surge into battle alongside their Idoneth kin, overwhelming the enemy with their unwavering focus and terrifying momentum. To witness such martial perfection is an inspiration to any Idoneth warrior.

details.notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as an *Akhelian Raidmaster*.

abilities.name: Rapid Approach
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use a **RUN** ability and still use **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.
abilities.lore: Moving with liquid speed and uncanny agility, the Ikon is on its foes before they have a chance to react.

abilities.name: The Surging Sea
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the targets, to a maximum of 3.
abilities.lore: The Ikon’s aura of calm yet fearsome power sweeps up nearby Idoneth, carrying them into battle like a racing current.

eidolon of mathlann aspect of the storm.name: Eidolon of Mathlann, Aspect of the Storm
eidolon of mathlann aspect of the storm.lore: In its aspect of the storm an Eidolon of Mathlann is the vengeance of the Idoneth made manifest, a living tempest that surges upwards before crashing upon the foe with tidal‑wave force.

weapons.name: Spear of Repressed Fury and Crulhook

abilities.name: Drench With Hate
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The mere presence of an Eidolon in its warrior aspect is enough to imbue nearby Idoneth with a fierce and bitter hate.

abilities.name: Crashing Upon The Foe
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT**  abilities.
abilities.lore: The Eidolon surges up into the sky before crashing down like a tidal wave, reforming to dive again and again until nothing is left of the enemy.

abilities.name: Pulled Into The Depths
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The viciously barbed crulhook can ensnare unfortunate foes.

volturnos high king of the deep.name: Volturnos, High King of the Deep
volturnos high king of the deep.lore: Volturnos is the last of the Cythai, a warrior whose cunning and prowess are legendary. Riding to battle atop Uasall, Prince of Deepmares, the High King carves a path through the foe, inspiring the Idoneth to ever greater deeds.

weapons.name: Uasall’s Fangs, Talons and Lashing Tails

abilities.name: First Among Akhelians
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by other friendly **AKHELIAN** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Volturnos is the greatest Akhelian King to have ever lived. His supreme skill and vast experience serve as an inspiration to all members of the Idoneth’s warrior caste.

abilities.name: Supreme Lord of Tides
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 other friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: At the High King’s command, his warriors will attack with unrelenting fury.

abilities.name: Cealith, the High King's Shield
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (3+)** against mortal damage inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities or abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**.
abilities.lore: Cealith is said to have been crafted by Teclis himself. However it was created, the mystical aura it projects guards the bearer against malign magics.

akhelian allopex.name: Akhelian Allopex
akhelian allopex.lore: Allopexes are vicious predators of the deep, known for their voracious appetites. As Akhelian bond-beasts, they are more dangerous still, boasting scythed fins and deadly back-mounted harpoon launchers. Even the bravest fear these finned menaces.

details.wargearOptionsText:
***This unit is armed with Barbed Hooks and Blades, Allopex’s Ferocious Bite and 1 of the following options:***

• ***Razorshell Harpoon***
• ***Retarius Net Launcher***

abilities.name: Bloodthirsty Predators
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Allopex’s Ferocious Bite** while it is within 6" of any damaged enemy units or while it is within 6" of any enemy units that had any models slain in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Allopexes are drawn towards the scent of freshly spilt blood.

abilities.name: Ensnared
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** or **CAVALRY** unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.
abilities.lore: The Akhelians are experts at ensnaring their prey with a well-placed harpoon or Retarius net.

namarti reavers.name: Namarti Reavers
namarti reavers.lore: Armed with silent‑firing whisperbows, Namarti Reavers are the fast‑moving scouts and archers of the Idoneth Deepkin Phalanxes. Despite their eerie and disturbing lack of eyes, they are uncannily accurate, using senses other than sight to pinpoint their targets.

abilities.name: Strike on the Move
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Namarti Reavers are experts at running out from cover to unleash a hail of deadly arrows.

endrinmaster with dirigible suit.name: Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit
endrinmaster with dirigible suit.lore: Many Endrinmasters take to the skies in master-crafted dirigible suits, their aetherturbines allowing them to zoom through the air towards skyvessels in need of repair even as an in-built weapon array blasts their enemies into pieces.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

abilities.name: Combat Engineers
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly **Endrinriggers** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, combat attacks made by the targets against enemy units that charged this turn have **Crit (2 Hits)**.
abilities.lore: Endrinmasters are trained in combat and possess a natural flair for command – bad news for would-be attackers.

abilities.name: Mobile Repairs
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, **Heal (3)** the target.
abilities.lore: An Endrinmaster is well equipped to carry out emergency repairs in the midst of battle.

aetheric navigator.name: Aetheric Navigator
aetheric navigator.lore: Utilising cutting-edge aethermatic science in order to decipher the ever-changing wind patterns of the Mortal Realms, Aetheric Navigators are an invaluable presence upon any Kharadron skyvessel.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

abilities.name: Aethersight
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.
abilities.lore: Aetheric Navigators can unpick enemy spells by harnessing the arcane jet streams.

abilities.name: Read the Winds
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **AUTO-ENDRIN** within this unit’s combat range and that is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, if the target is a **SKYVESSEL**, you can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the target and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Navigators can signal to nearby Kharadron airships, helping them to steer into prevailing currents.

arkanaut ironclad.name: Arkanaut Ironclad
arkanaut ironclad.lore: Amongst the heaviest Kharadron ships of the line, the redoubtable Ironclads provide a floating fortress at the heart of any airfleet, bombarding their targets from afar with explosive shells and armour-piercing torpedoes.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Great Sky Ordnance** is 4.

abilities.name: Transport Capacity
